newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi hikes Dec Light, Extra Light to Asia-traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi hikes Dec Light, Extra Light to Asia-traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia raised its price formula for December-lifting Arab Light and Extra Light crude oil to Asian customers by 15 to 30 cents per barrel while lowering Arab Heavy crude by 10 cents, traders said on Tuesday.

The December term contract price for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai differential plus 75 cents, compared with a premium of 60 cents for November, while the December price for Berri Extra Light was raised by 30 cents to a premium of $1.85, traders said.
The December contract price for Arab Heavy was set at the Oman/Dubai differential minus $1.15, down 10 cents from its November discount.
Arab Medium was priced at the Oman/Dubai differential minus 30 cents for December, unchanged from November, traders said.
